title: AζAR's Architectural Amenities
description: This mod adds a handful of blocks that aid in adding more personality to your builds.
body:
AζAR's Architectural Amenities is a mod that aims to add a variety of blocks to aid in adding personality and detail to your builds



# **Features**


## **Crestshale**
![The crestshale blocks on a background of quartz](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/950302649776af705f1bf81aafdeb71cf12a6408.png)

Crestshale is a new, blue form of stone that can be found at the top of mountains. It can be crafted into Crestshale bricks. 

## **Paintings**
![All of the added paintings on a quartz background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93da30b6672a5b66e3c65494daa5ada20d411f1f.png)

AAA adds a lot of pixelised famous paintings, which include, but are not limited to: The Mona Lisa, The creation of adam, and starry night.

## **Dyes**
![An image of goopstem, english lavender, and soulbloom](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d82722fff8829f951d6e6dea1cca39f5552fb03.png)

AAA adds 3 new plants:

**Goopstem** - Which can be found in swamps and crafted into green dye

**English lavender** - Which can be found in deserts and crafted into purple dye

**Soulbloom** - Which can be found in soulsand valleys and crafted into cyan dye

## **Misc**
![Other misc blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aafdf933d0a1b5a5c8b910829e69d2e54720b421.png)

There are also a few other misc blocks that are added by AAA

# End Statement

Obviously, these are just the start, and the count of blocks will grow, quite a bit.

Any and all recommendations for blocks and other things that YOU want to be added can be spoken in the discord! I will attempt to honour all requests made.
